title: Cyprus 2026: statutory rules, measured statistics and modelling assumptions

parameters.label: Employee Social Insurance contribution
parameters.evidence: "22.8%, of which 8.8% is paid by the employee, 8.8% by the employer and 5.2% from the Consolidated Fund … contribution year beginning on or after 1st of January 2024"
parameters.explanation: Employees in a non-contributory occupational pension scheme have a different split (4.45/13.15/5.2), not modelled.

parameters.label: Employer Social Insurance contribution
parameters.explanation: Paid by the employer to the Social Insurance Fund.

parameters.label: State Social Insurance contribution (employees)
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; paid by the Consolidated Fund for employed persons
parameters.explanation: A government transfer to the Fund; NOT part of the employer's labour cost.

parameters.label: Self-employed Social Insurance contribution
parameters.evidence: "21.8%, of which 16.6% is paid by the self-employed and 5.2% from the Consolidated Fund … 2024"; Table II "CONTR. PERC. 16,6%"
parameters.explanation: Insurable income is at least an occupational-category minimum (€331.14–€982.38/week in 2026).

parameters.label: State Social Insurance contribution (self-employed)
parameters.explanation: Government transfer to the Fund on self-employed insurable income; not paid by the self-employed person.

parameters.label: Maximum insurable earnings, monthly-paid employees
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; per employee per monthly pay period
parameters.evidence: "(β) Ανώτατο όριο για μηνιαίους εργοδοτούμενους: €5.742 από 1/1/2026"
parameters.explanation: Applied per employee and per pay period; never to total payroll.

parameters.label: Maximum insurable earnings, weekly-paid employees
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; per employee per weekly pay period; also self-employed weekly maximum
parameters.evidence: "(α) Ανώτατο όριο για εβδομαδιαίους εργοδοτούμενους: €1.325 από 5/1/2026"
parameters.explanation: Per employee per weekly pay period; the weekly maximum also bounds self-employed insurable income (52 × €1,325 = €68,900/year).

parameters.label: Maximum insurable earnings, annual (reference)
parameters.evidence: "€1.325 per week, €5.742 per month and €68.904 per annum" (KPMG). Official notice gives only weekly/monthly limits.
parameters.explanation: Not stated in any official page found; equals 12 × €5,742 (52 × €1,325 = €68,900). Calculations use the per-period ceilings.

parameters.label: Basic insurable earnings
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; basis for self-employed minimums and benefits
parameters.explanation: Reference amount for self-employed minimum insurable income (× occupational coefficient 1.5–4.45) and for benefits.

parameters.label: Employee SI rate from 2029
parameters.evidence: "24.1%, of which 9.3% is paid by the employee, 9.3% by the employer and 5.5% from the Consolidated Fund … on or after 1st of January 2029"
parameters.explanation: Scheduled change; law number not confirmed (cylaw.org inaccessible). Separate from the 2026 baseline.

parameters.label: Employer SI rate from 2029
parameters.explanation: Scheduled +0.5pp step for employers; configurable timeline, separate from the 2026 baseline.

parameters.label: State SI rate from 2029
parameters.explanation: Scheduled +0.3pp step for the state contribution.

parameters.label: Central Holiday Fund (minimum statutory leave)
parameters.units: fraction of earnings up to SI ceiling
parameters.coverage: Cyprus; employers without exemption; 20 days' leave, 5-day week
parameters.evidence: rate depends on leave entitlement: 8% (20 days) to 16% (40 days)
parameters.explanation: Optional per employee in the calculator; 8% is the statutory-minimum-leave case.

parameters.label: Cap on deductible SI, GHS, life insurance and pension/provident contributions
parameters.evidence: "… Social Insurance Contributions, must not exceed one fifth of your taxable income"
parameters.explanation: Combined cap (1/5). Implemented as 1/5 of gross employment income before these deductions; other qualifying items (life insurance, provident funds) are user inputs.

parameters.label: Child deduction (first child)
parameters.explanation: €1,250 second, €1,500 third and further; doubled for single-parent families. Not applied automatically (user input).

parameters.label: Rent or mortgage-interest deduction (main residence)
parameters.explanation: Not applied automatically (user input).

parameters.label: Family income ceiling for new deductions (0–2 children)
parameters.evidence: "€100.000 για οικογένειες χωρίς τέκνα ή με ένα (1) ή δύο (2) τέκνα"
parameters.explanation: €150,000 for 3–4 children, €200,000 for 5+, €40,000 for single persons.

parameters.label: First-employment exemption (20%) annual cap
parameters.coverage: New residents meeting conditions (conditions from secondary source)
parameters.evidence: "20% of your emoluments … with a maximum of €8.550"
parameters.explanation: Not applied automatically; conditions corroborated by PwC only.

parameters.label: Corporate income tax rate
parameters.evidence: "Από την 1/1/2026, οι εταιρείες υπόκεινται σε εταιρικό φόρο με συντελεστή ύψους 15%."
parameters.explanation: A tax on taxable corporate profit; NOT the paper's effective capital-income tax (see MODEL_DEVIATIONS C6). 12.5% until 31/12/2025.

parameters.label: Special Defence Contribution on dividends (domiciled individuals)
parameters.explanation: 17% still applies to dividends paid by 31/12/2031 out of profits of 2025 or earlier.

parameters.label: Standard VAT rate
parameters.explanation: Reduced rates 9%, 5% (and 3%, 0% per PwC).

parameters.evidence: "the total maximum annual amount on which contributions will be paid is € 180,000"

parameters.label: Redundancy Fund (employer)

parameters.evidence: "Contribution rate 1.2%"; ceiling notice covers the Redundancy Fund
parameters.explanation: Separate fund collected via SIS.

parameters.label: Notional interest deduction (2026 status)
